---
name: Tool request
about: Suggest a tool for zeal.tools
title: "[tool] "
labels: tool-request
---

**What tool do you need?**

A one-line description, e.g. "Invoice generator that outputs PDF".

**What did you search for?**

The words you typed when you couldn't find it — this helps our search keywords too.

**What would you use it for?**

A sentence or two about the job to be done.

**Anything the existing alternatives do badly?**

Watermarks, sign-up walls, broken mobile, ads on the download button…
